about_the_game:
ExoDomia

'Three decades ago, the Robotic Empire of Dana sought to invade our Galaxy.

Through great struggle, humanity pushed back their invasion into their own cluster of space.

The distance between us became the galactic demilitarised zone.

Four months ago, our military intercepted a message originating from this place.

The message held dark tidings, a warning of a chemical weapon designed to eradicate all biological life.

One week ago, our squad was selected to breach the dmz to authenticate this message.

If we are caught, we'll never see home again.'

- Captain Fletcher - Year: 3659 - Month: 13 - Day: 37 - AGD

What does this demo include?

The 'ExoDomia Demo' only provides access to the first level in the game. This level contains three weapons to choose from (Assault Rifle, Pump Shotgun & Pistol) and five unique enemy types to fight, including a mini-boss. Features such as the 'EnviroScan' from the main build is also accessible here as well for you to try but it's use cases are limited.

What differs the 'ExoDomia Demo' from the main game?

The full version of 'ExoDomia' grants the player access to explore the world of 'Salakar V', offering more narrative, weapons and enemies for you to encounter.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 - 8400
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1050ti
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: This is the lowest specs we've had access to, which runs at around 30fps on medium settings.

short_description: Exodomia is a narrative-driven, action-adventure game set on the robotic world of Salakar V! In this fast-paced combat experience, you will encounter many dangerous creatures and enemies as you navigate a story of struggle and survival.
